title: Photography style
slide_intent: Teach photographers to combine proximity, natural light and a focal point so a reader can follow what is happening in a busy moment.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can establish a recognizable reportage approach across work made in different places.
demonstration: A six-image grid assigns one production choice to each photograph, including ambient light, focus, activity, viewpoint and proximity.
practical_value: Use the six captions as a brief for a shoot. Select a viewpoint close enough to the action and check where the eye lands inside the frame.

content_islands.name: Section introduction
content_islands.spec: Set the title beside the navigation and summarize the reportage approach beneath it.

content_islands.name: Six style specimens
content_islands.spec: Arrange two rows of three photographs on the right. Place the bold technique name and its explanation directly under each photograph so a reader can compare the choice with the image.
